# Zunair Shahid — Shopify Plus Developer

> Certified Shopify Plus developer based in Lahore, Pakistan. Builds and scales ecommerce stores for brands across the US, UK, and Canada.

## Who

Zunair Shahid is a Certified Shopify Plus Developer with 8+ years of experience and 100+ Shopify / Shopify Plus stores shipped. Focus: long-term partnerships over one-off projects — fewer clients, deeper relationships, and retainers after launch.

## Core services

- Shopify Plus store builds and custom Liquid themes
- WooCommerce → Shopify migrations (SEO-safe, staged cutovers)
- Custom Shopify app development (private and public)
- Conversion rate optimization (CRO)
- Ongoing retainers for maintenance, features, and priority support
